create_LogisticNormal: create a LogisticNormal distribution from loc and scale parameters for PyTorch
sample_LogisticNormal: sample from a LogisticNormal distribution given loc and scale tensors
get_LogisticNormal_loc: get the loc parameter of a LogisticNormal distribution
